userImpact: On /me the 'Projects' tab (My memberships) is broken for ALL roles, every load. listProjectPositions({activePersonId,take:200}) returns HTTP 400, ProjectsTab.tsx has no fallback so it renders a dead-end ErrorState ('Couldn't load memberships' / 'take must not be greater than 200, take must not be less than 1, take must be an integer number'). No user can see their project assignments from /me. The other 7 /me tabs (Overview, Time, Leave, Skills, Cases, Inbox, Settings) are unaffected and /me otherwise renders fine; the shell's Projects tab badge count also fails but degrades silently (catch->null). Reproduced for director and employee because it is role-independent — the same 400 fires for every authenticated user. Note: every other listProjectPositions caller that sends take/skip (PulseTab take:50, ProjectPositionsList take:100, ExportCentre take:500, CommandPalette take:15, etc.) hits the same 400 — broader than /me, but the wider blast radius is out of scope for this finding.
rootCause: ListProjectPositionsQueryDto (src/modules/project-positions/application/contracts/project-position-requests.ts:223-234) declares `take?: number` with `@IsInt() @Min(1) @Max(200)` and `skip?: number` with `@IsInt() @Min(0)` but NO `@Type(() => Number)` decorator. Express delivers query params as strings, so `take` arrives as the string '200'. The global ValidationPipe (src/main.ts:67-72) is `new ValidationPipe({ transform: true, whitelist: true })` WITHOUT `transformOptions.enableImplicitConversion: true`. `transform: true` alone instantiates the DTO class but does NOT coerce primitive query-string properties to numbers, so `@IsInt()` runs against the string '200' and fails -> 400. Sibling query DTOs in the same codebase use the correct pattern (e.g. case-management/application/contracts/list-cases.query.ts:20-25 `@IsOptional() @Type(() => Number) @IsInt()`), proving this DTO is the deviation. The 400 is NOT from an unknown/whitelisted param (whitelist strips silently, forbidNonWhitelisted is off per main.ts:64-66 SEC-17) and NOT from activePersonId (the UUID-shape @Matches passes for a string UUID); it is purely the numeric-coercion gap on take/skip.
suggestedFix: Add `@Type(() => Number)` (import { Type } from 'class-transformer') above the `@IsInt()` on both `take` and `skip` in ListProjectPositionsQueryDto (project-position-requests.ts:223-234), matching list-cases.query.ts. Minimal, surgical, and consistent with the codebase. (Alternative/global: set `transformOptions: { enableImplicitConversion: true }` on the ValidationPipe in main.ts:68 — fixes this and the same class of bug everywhere, but is a broader behavioral change; prefer the per-DTO @Type fix for this finding.)
pageState: /me?tab=projects -> ProjectsTab renders <ErrorState title='Couldn't load memberships' description='take must not be greater than 200, take must not be less than 1, take must be an integer number'>. Dead-end: ErrorState here exposes no retry/forward action and a retry would 400 again deterministically (borderline UX Law 2 violation). The /me shell, header, tab strip, and all other tabs render normally; Projects tab badge count is blank.
evidence: RUNTIME REPRO (exact prod pipe + DTO decorators): `new ValidationPipe({transform:true,whitelist:true}).transform({activePersonId:'<uuid>',take:'200'},{type:'query',metatype:DTO})` -> threw HTTP status 400, body {"message":["take must not be greater than 200","take must not be less than 1","take must be an integer number"],"error":"Bad Request","statusCode":400}. CONTROL with `transformOptions:{enableImplicitConversion:true}` -> PASS, take coerced to number 200. SOURCE: src/main.ts:67-72 (ValidationPipe transform:true, NO enableImplicitConversion); src/modules/project-positions/application/contracts/project-position-requests.ts:223-234 (take/skip @IsInt with no @Type); src/modules/project-positions/presentation/project-positions.controller.ts:113-132 (GET / binds @Query() ListProjectPositionsQueryDto, passes query.take straight through). FE: frontend/src/routes/me/ProjectsTab.tsx:38 (listProjectPositions({activePersonId, take:200})) + :42-43 .catch sets error + :68 ErrorState (no fallback); frontend/src/lib/api/project-positions.ts:185 (toQueryString appends take as raw string) + :192 httpGet; frontend/src/lib/api/http-client.ts:120-135 (throws ApiError joining message array). Shell silent-degrade site: frontend/src/routes/me/WorkspaceShellPage.tsx:111-112 (.catch(()=>null)). Counter-evidence that this is a code defect not env: sibling list-cases.query.ts:20-25 uses @Type(()=>Number)@IsInt() correctly; no HTTP-level integration/e2e test exercises GET /project-positions with query params, so the bug is untested (controller unit specs call the method directly, bypassing the pipe).
